subject: Physics
q: Four resistors of 15 Ω, 12 Ω, 4 Ω and 10 Ω are connected in that cyclic order to form a Wheatstone network. What resistance, in ohms, must be connected in parallel with the 10 Ω resistor to balance the network?
hint: First find the required equivalent resistance of the arm containing 10 Ω from the Wheatstone balance condition.
solution: For four arms in cyclic order, balance requires the products of opposite arms to be equal. If R is the new equivalent resistance of the 10 Ω arm, then 15 × 4 = 12 × R, so R = 5 Ω. A 10 Ω resistor in parallel with another 10 Ω resistor gives 5 Ω. Therefore the required added resistance is 10 Ω.
